SM shall report the entered sub-state towards the BswM by calling BswM_EthSM_Cur-
rentState(<entered sub-state>) (e.g.
when entering sub-state ETHSM_STATE_ON-
LINE, EthSM shall call BswM_EthSM_CurrentState(ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE). The
transistion to ETHSM_STATE_OFFLINE after initialization (see [SWS_EthSM_00025])
shall not be reported towards the BswM.⌋()
Note:
